newsitem.title: INDIA: YIELD AT INDIAN 364-DAY T-BILL SLIPS TO 8.35 PCT.
newsitem.headline: YIELD AT INDIAN 364-DAY T-BILL SLIPS TO 8.35 PCT.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 92.31 rupees at an auction of 364-day treasury bills on Wednesday.
Dealers said the yield fell to 8.35 percent, down from 8.45 percent at last fortnight's auction.
The RBI said it received 56 bids for 15.98 billion rupees of which it accepted 32 for 9.93 billion rupees.
The devolvement on primary dealers, in fulfillment of their underwriting commitment, was 800 million rupees, RBI said.
The face value of total bills issued was 10.73 billion.
The weighted average cut-off rate was 92.33 rupees.
